tools.name: suggest_classes
tools.description: Maps a plain description of what a business sells onto the Nice classes a trademark filing would need. Call this before check_name whenever the user has not given class numbers.

tools.name: search_international
tools.description: Searches WIPO Madrid System international registrations by name, showing for each one the countries it was designated in and the countries that refused it. Use this for questions about protecting a name abroad.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Returns the current state of a check started earlier, using the job id it gave you. Call it again after a short wait while the status is still running.
